verdict.rationale: Blink is a native SSH/Mosh client: the docs show typing `ssh [user@]hostname` or `mosh [user@]hostname` straight to your own hosts, with saved Hosts entries, SSH keys, tunnels (-L), proxycommand and scp/sftp. A hands-on user reports using it directly against machines on their LAN, which corroborates direct, relay-free connections. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that no vendor cloud relay or proxy sits in the connection path.
